request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
Dolos is described as a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides efficient access to chain data without the overhead of traditional full nodes.
Dolos exposes five query interfaces, including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C unix socket compatible with Cardano-cli, Ogmios, and other tooling.
The proposal states that Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.

The maintainer scope includes dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, documentation, issue triage, contribution review, public communication, and AI-friendly integration resources.
The proposal states that Dolos achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
The proposal states that audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect administration and technically capable third parties.
The proposal states that TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

The proposal states that Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with named reserve and project-specific addresses, role-based permissions, an Oversight Committee, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA to fund 12 months of Dolos maintenance by TxPipe through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, citing open-source infrastructure value, prior Intersect budget support, NCL compliance, oversight controls, and measurable repository activity.
